notes.title: Bridge stage update
notes.content: Grubs and other weak enemies added to stage 3 (bridge stage).

notes.title: Card Flash
notes.content:
Card selection music added and music for good/bad joker card draws. Cards now flash bright when first on screen and cannot be selected accidentally when flashing.

Xp upgrade cards are now introduced to the game in stages to prevent players getting over powered too early in the game and ruining the balance of progress.

Wave 5 +2 XP card added to the deck.
Wave 10 another +2 XP card added.
Wave 15 +4 XP card added to the deck.
Wave 20 +8 XP card added to the Joker card deck.
Wave 25 +12 XP card added to the Joker card deck.

notes.title: Temp roll back
notes.content: Last build created some bugs so rolled back for now.

notes.title: July Update
notes.content:
Card selection music added and music for good/bad joker card draws. Cards now flash bright when first on screen and cannot be selected accidentally when flashing. 

Xp upgrade cards are now introduced to the game in stages to prevent players getting over powered too early in the game and ruining the balance of progress. 

Wave 5 +2 XP card added to the deck. 
Wave 10 another +2 XP card added.
Wave 15 +4 XP card added to the deck.
Wave 20 +8 XP card added to the Joker card deck.
Wave 25 +12 XP card added to the Joker card deck.

notes.title: 7/7/25 Patch Skip Track Added
notes.content: Skip track button added so you can cycle through the background music.

notes.title: Stage 4 added
notes.content:
New stage 4 has been added. Well, the old stage 1 is now stage 4 and there is a new stage 1. 

Head-butt has been removed as it was over powered. 

Aim assist (that was the old default style) can now be toggled off and on for gamepad players by pressing the Y button on an Xbox 360 style pad. 

Gamepad controls are visible on the stage/character select screen when you press any button. 

Music volume issues have been fixed and music now plays for stage 2.

notes.title: Notes for 9th May 2025
notes.content: Bullet particles added, impacts now also have particle effects. Hit damage numbers have been added. As enemies have less that 50% health they have a distorted noise effect which increases when they have 25% or less health. This helps you identify the weaker enemies on screen. All these new features can be switched off in the pause or options menu.

notes.title: Weapons Update 11/4/25
notes.content: Three new weapons added! Headbutt, Fireball and Gas! Numerous tweaks and edits have been made as well but the weapons are the big updates.

notes.title: 27 Feb New Stage Update
notes.content:
New bridge stage added!

 Includes fix bridge and harder bridge cards. 

Also Ninja Star weapon added with throw+1 and Bigger star cards. 

Boomerangs now do more damage. 

Launch+1 rocket card is now in the regular card deck once you select the rocket weapon.

notes.title: Stage 2 gamepad aim improved.
notes.content: Minor tweaks + improved the gamepad aim controls for Stage 2.

notes.title: Big Update! New stage added!
notes.content:
Stage 2 added with loads of new enemies to shoot and gameplay across several screens. 40 waves to survive and 3 bosses to kill. This stage is shorter than stage 1 and has a final boss fight.

New Gem Multi card added - this multiplies the value of the gems you collect. This will make unlocking characters and adding permanent upgrades much easier.

notes.title: New cards update.
notes.content:
11 new cards added!

Random rocket card. Shoot rockets which create an area of effect blast with 2x damage.
Bigger Boom card works with this ability - makes the blast area larger.
Launch +1  rocket is a Jocker deck card for this weapon.

Homing missile card. Short range homing missiles. Deal 1.5 damage.
Missile Fuel card makes these last longer before exploding.

Boomerang card. Throw boomerangs which return to you and cannot be destroyed by enemy fire. They deal half damage on collision with enemies.
Throw Further card added for boomerangs.
Throw +1 is a Jocker deck card for this weapon. 

Explode enemy card- enemies explode and release shrapnel on death.
Shrapnel deals 0.25 damage.

Crit Hit card. Bullets have a change for a critical hit (double damage).
Crit Hit Multi card in the Joker deck multiplies the Crit Hit damage.

notes.title: December 2 Update
notes.content: 3 new enemy types added for the later stages. 4 New achievements to unlock.
